title: Ing metung a pasyenti
intro: Kanitang minunang panaun, king minunang panaun ning kasalesayan ning tau, ating aduang kaladwa a tinalakad arapan ning karelang Miglalang a maki ain. Metung ing tinggap, ing metung ali. Ing tinuki maging yang mumunang maragul a trahedya kareng mikakapatad - metung a gawa ning pamagpigil at metung a gawa ning mapait a pamangimut. Malyari meng abalu nung ninu ku?
clues: mibait ku keng mumunang aldo ning pangatau keti keng yatu
anak ku ning mumunang pares da reng taung miglakad keng yatu
Misan miyain kung ain-sakripisyu ibat karing pekamasanting karing kawan ku ban apasaya ke ing kanakung Miglalang
Ing ain ku tinggap de ibat babo, kabang ing ain ning kapatad ku e ya metanggap
Inyang banta da kung paten, pinili kung e itas ing gamat ku laban keng kapatad ku
aku ing meging mumunang tau keng mabilug a amlat ning tau na mepate keng aliwa

trial.answer: Ing mumunang pamakamate keng amlat ning tau

location.label: Key Element

Metung a maragul a daung a gawa king dutung

Metung a ayup a hoopoe a magdalang mensahi ning ari

location.answer: Metung a tupa a miyain bilang makatula a ain

outcome.label: Kelabasan
options: Meging mumunang biktima ning pamakamate king amlat ning tau
Mekaligtas ya keng maragul a albug kilub ning metung a saken a gawa keng dutung
menuknangan ya kilub ning atian ning maragul a asan
Mag-ari ya kareng jinn, tau, ampo ing angin
Miglakbe kilub ning apat apulung banua king malawak a ilang
outcome.answer: Meging mumunang biktima ning pamakamate king amlat ning tau

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
